data.title: Zoom Poised for Long-Term Value Creation as Analyst Highlights AI-Driven Platform Evolution and Credible FY2030 Profit Targets
data.description:
Zoom Communications Inc, the Technology sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst on October 20. Analyst Robert Oliver from Robert W. Baird maintained a Buy rating on the stock and has a $115.00 price target.

Robert Oliver has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Zoom’s evolving platform and long-term outlook. He sees Zoom transitioning from a pure communications tool into an AI-driven system of action, integrating meetings, phone, contact center, and workflow tools through a unified context layer that deepens customer engagement and supports higher-value use cases.

He also views management’s FY2030 targets as credible, with mid- to high-single-digit revenue growth, robust 80% adjusted gross margins, and strong operating profitability, all supported by accelerating enterprise adoption and AI monetization. Additionally, Zoom’s expanding cross-sell into Phone, Rooms, Webinars, and ZoomCX, combined with disciplined capital returns via share-reducing buybacks, reinforces his conviction that earnings and shareholder value can grow meaningfully over time.
